The ONE bundled fixture day the gate-config editor's live preview evaluates, ported verbatim from the RN oracle's GATE_PREVIEW_FIXTURE (mobile/src/compute/gateConfigPreview.ts). NOT live data and NOT a hub-contract capture: a fixed, hand-picked interval-day case chosen so an edited threshold visibly moves the verdict. today = 2026-08-25 (a Tuesday -> sessionByWeekday[1] = Norwegian 4x4 intervals) with sleep_duration_h 6.2. Under the default config (minSleepH 6.0) every interval-gate check passes -> 'GO — Norwegian 4x4 intervals'; raising minSleepH past 6.2 fails `dur >= config.minSleepH` inside evaluate() and flips the verdict to 'MODIFIED — swap intervals for easy Z2 30-40min'. Mirrored by the inline `GatePreviewFixture.bundled` constant in GateConfigPreview.swift; GateConfigPreviewTests asserts the two never drift.
